events.summary: William H. Gates III joins the board. Basis: proxy 'Director Since: 1981' (pre-IPO; no filing gives a month or day).
John W. Thompson joins the board. Basis: 8-K Item 5.02 (appointed 2012-02-17); Form 3 event date agrees.
Satya Nadella joins the board. Basis: 8-K Item 5.02 (appointed CEO and director, effective immediately); Form 3 event date agrees.
John W. Stanton joins the board. Basis: 8-K Item 5.02 (appointed effective immediately); Form 3 event date agrees.
Teri L. List joins the board. Basis: 8-K Item 5.02 (appointed 2014-09-16, effective October 1); Form 3 event date 2014-10-01 agrees.
Charles W. Scharf joins the board. Basis: 8-K Item 5.02 (appointed 2014-09-16, effective October 1); Form 3 event date 2014-10-01 agrees.
Sandra E. Peterson joins the board. Basis: Elected at the 2015 annual meeting; 2015 proxy says her term begins 2015-12-02; Form 3 event date agrees.
Padmasree Warrior joins the board. Basis: Elected at the 2015 annual meeting; 2015 proxy says her term begins 2015-12-02; Form 3 event date agrees.
Reid G. Hoffman joins the board. Basis: 8-K Item 5.02 (appointed effective immediately); Form 3 event date agrees.
Hugh F. Johnston joins the board. Basis: 8-K Item 5.02 (appointed effective immediately); Form 3 event date agrees.
Penny S. Pritzker joins the board. Basis: Elected at the 2017 annual meeting; 2017 proxy says her term begins 2017-11-29; Form 3 event date agrees.
Arne M. Sorenson joins the board. Basis: Elected at the 2017 annual meeting; 2017 proxy says his term begins 2017-11-29; Form 3 event date agrees.
Emma N. Walmsley joins the board. Basis: Elected at the 2019 annual meeting; 2019 proxy says her term begins 2019-12-04; Form 3 event date agrees.
Carlos A. Rodriguez joins the board. Basis: Elected at the 2021 annual meeting; 2021 proxy says his term begins 2021-11-30; Form 3 event date agrees.

Catherine MacGregor joins the board. Basis: Elected at the 2023 annual meeting; 2023 proxy says her term begins 2023-12-07 and the 2024 proxy says she joined effective 2023-12-07; Form 3 event date agrees.

Mark A. L. Mason joins the board. Basis: Elected at the 2023 annual meeting; 2023 proxy says his term begins 2023-12-07 and the 2024 proxy says he joined effective 2023-12-07; Form 3 event date agrees.
John David Rainey joins the board. Basis: Elected at the 2025 annual meeting; 2025 proxy says his term begins 2025-12-05; Form 3 event date agrees.
Carmine Di Sibio joins the board. Basis: 8-K Item 5.02 (appointed effective May 13, 2026); Form 3 event date agrees.
Bill Gates resigns from the board effective 2020-03-13 (to focus on philanthropy; remains Technology Advisor).
Arne Sorenson dies in office in February 2021 (day not disclosed in SEC filings reviewed).
Nadella elected board chair (Chairman and CEO); Thompson moves from Chairman to lead independent director.
Thompson ends as Chairman and becomes lead independent director.
Board size increased from 11 to 12 effective 2021-11-30 (Rodriguez's election).
Peterson becomes lead independent director (and G&N chair, leaving the Compensation chair), succeeding Thompson.
Thompson's service ends at the 2023 annual meeting (did not stand for re-election).
Warrior's service ends at the 2023 annual meeting (did not stand for re-election).
Rodriguez's service ends at the 2025 annual meeting (did not stand for re-election, personal reasons).
Board expanded from 12 to 13 members with Di Sibio's appointment.

conflicts.description: The 2023 annual-meeting 8-K body says the meeting was held 'On December 7, 2022', but its cover gives the event date as December 7, 2023, and the 2023 proxy (terms beginning December 7, 2023) and the 2024 proxy (joined / retired effective December 7, 2023) agree on 2023. The 2022 in the body is a typo; 2023-12-07 used.

Thompson's 2012 appointment 8-K names him 'John E. Thompson'; his Form 3 reads 'THOMPSON JOHN WENDELL' and every proxy and the 2014 press release use 'John W. Thompson'. Same person (same CIK across filings); recorded as an alias.

Thompson's chair role ended 2021-06-16 (8-K and 2021 proxy), but the 2021 proxy also says his 'Independent Board Chair compensation continued through June 30, 2021'. That is a pay detail, not the role date; role end kept at 2021-06-16.

open_questions: Reid Hoffman will leave at the 2026 annual meeting (8-K filed 2026-06-05). No 2026 proxy had been filed by 2026-10-04, so the meeting date (his end date) is not yet known. Past meetings were in late November or early December.

Carmine Di Sibio (appointed 2026-05-13): no filing through 2026-10-04 makes an independence determination for him. His committees (Audit, Compensation) come only from the appointment 8-K. The next proxy should settle both.
John David Rainey's committee assignments after his 2025-12-05 election are not disclosed in any filing reviewed. The 2025 proxy says only that the Board would consider them after his election.
Who chairs the Compensation Committee after Rodriguez left (2025-12-05) is not disclosed in any filing reviewed.

Arne Sorenson's exact date of death (February 2021) is not in any SEC filing reviewed. Microsoft filed no 8-K for it. An S-4 signature page dated 2021-02-16 still lists him as a director, but unsigned.
Thompson's first lead independent director stint is dated only by year (2012-2014). The month it started is not disclosed.
Bill Gates' board start is year-only (1981, 'Director Since'). That is before the 1986 IPO and before EDGAR.
Independence roles are aligned to board tenure. The filings give point-in-time determinations (one per proxy).
Committee membership is captured at the 2025 proxy, the Di Sibio 8-K, and each departed director's last proxy. Changes between filings are not tracked.
Other-board lists come from Microsoft's own proxy bios (the 2026-05-14 press release for Di Sibio) and are not checked against other issuers' filings.

coverage.method: Roster from the 2025 DEF 14A and the 2025-12-08 8-K (Items 5.02/5.07), checked against every 8-K filed after the proxy (the only Item 5.02s: 2026-05-14 Di Sibio and 2026-06-05 Hoffman), the 2026-07-29 10-K signature page (13 directors), the Form 3s for new directors, and the September 2026 director Form 4s, through the last filing in the EDGAR feed (2026-09-17).

Every DEF 14A from 2019 to 2025 and every 8-K with Item 5.02 or 5.07 filed 2019-09 through 2026-10 reviewed; the item list of every 8-K checked; every Form 3 filed since 2019 identified. Departures dated from 8-Ks and proxies (Sorenson to the month).
Only seats held by directors serving on or after 2020-01-01 are included (start dates from 8-Ks, proxies and Form 3s). Earlier departures (e.g. Noski and Panke on 2019-12-04) are out of scope.
